rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, Line 22: "On line 22, column (ii), enter the amount of the QPVLI, if any, that was deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)." fr-2025-24154 p. 23, proposed § 1.163-16(g)(1): "Independently deductible interest is limited to interest that is QPVLI ... and that is otherwise deductible by the taxpayer as a different type of interest"; (g)(2): the QPVLI "is reduced to the extent that the taxpayer deducts that independently deductible interest as non-QPVLI". fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A): "payments of interest and principal are allocated to the portion of the indebtedness described in paragraph (d)(2)(i) ... and the portion ... described in paragraph (d)(2)(ii) ... on a pro rata basis", and (d)(4): "A taxpayer allocates principal and interest between the amount of the new loan that is an SPVL and the remaining portion of the indebtedness on a pro rata basis". The candidate enters the smaller of the whole Schedule C interest and the loan's QPVLI, so on a partly qualifying loan it treats the business-use interest as QPVLI first; the text allocates every payment of interest pro rata between the qualifying and nonqualifying parts and gives no ordering that puts the deducted interest in the qualifying part. It also asks column (ii) of every loan, and prorates refinancings and mixed loans with a three-place ratio. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/carloan.deepseek.json; 1,111 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 74 partial records): 114 of 151 agree; 34 candidate-unknown (17 on completed returns), 3 value. Value witnesses: stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated (ratio 0.8, Schedule C $106.00): project $84.80, candidate $106.00; classm.carloan.3 (ratio 0.256638, Schedule C $2,149.00): project $551.52, candidate $2,149.00 (all of it, against QPVLI $2,209.17); classm.carloan.2: project $0.00, candidate $1,268.00, column (ii) supplied without a Schedule C (not an interview record). The candidate-unknown are returns without a Schedule C where it still needs carloan.col_ii_input (representation, as in the Claude log). BUG-0175 check: the fix is right. The Schedule C interest is a share of the whole loan's interest, and (d)(2)(iii)(A)/(d)(4) spread every payment of interest pro rata over the qualifying and nonqualifying parts, so the QPVLI part of it is the same ratio times it; (g)(1) admits only that part to column (ii) (p. 23 Example 1: $400 of $1,000 deducted as business interest leaves $600 of QPVLI, pp. 23-24). The refinanced branch uses the (d)(4) ratio and an inherited loan the (d)(2)(iii) ratio, both the ratios that carloan.qpvli uses, and an ineligible loan has no QPVLI, so zero. Regression stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated (interest $424.00, loan $20,000.00, $4,000.00 nonqualifying, Schedule C $106.00): column (ii) $84.80, column (iii) $254.40 = 0.8 x ($424.00 - $106.00). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 110, Line 22: "On line 22, column (iii), enter the total amount of the QPVLI paid or accrued on the loan during the taxable year minus the amount on line 22, column (ii)." fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A): "payments of interest and principal are allocated to the portion of the indebtedness described in paragraph (d)(2)(i) ... and the portion ... described in paragraph (d)(2)(ii) ... on a pro rata basis", and (d)(4): "A taxpayer allocates principal and interest between the amount of the new loan that is an SPVL and the remaining portion of the indebtedness on a pro rata basis"; fr-2025-24154 p. 21, (d)(2)(iii)(A): the allocation applies only "if a taxpayer incurs indebtedness described in both paragraphs (d)(2)(i) and (ii) of this section as part of the same transaction". The candidate prorates every loan by carloan.financed (zero when it is zero), so on a loan that financed only the vehicle it needs the amount financed, which the text does not; it inherits column (ii)'s min-not-prorate reading; and its three-place ratio is the register's third reading (amb.2025.carloan_ratio_places (chosen: ratio rounded half-up to six places; recorded alternatives: exact ratio, three places)). Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/carloan.deepseek.json): 106 of 151 agree; 27 candidate-unknown (17 on completed returns), 18 value. Witnesses: stage12.car.basic (completed, carloan.mixed false) candidate unknown on carloan.financed, as in round 1; stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated project $254.40, candidate $233.20 and classm.carloan.3 project $1,654.54, candidate $60.17 (column (ii) not prorated); classm.f5695.6 (refinanced, ratio 43,108/60,468) project $6,996.46, candidate $6,997.38 and generated 317 (mixed) project $6,899.95, candidate $6,898.17 (three-place ratio, ambiguity). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; the returned IR violates the explicitly supplied closed schema/type/reference interface: carloan.carloan.col_iii: reference 'carloan.qpvli' does not resolve. The candidate is rejected and not executed or repaired. This adjudicates the unusable declaration, not the underlying tax reading; source qualification still requires a valid replacement.

Ruling: model error; fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A): only "if a taxpayer incurs indebtedness described in both paragraphs (d)(2)(i) and (ii) of this section as part of the same transaction, the indebtedness must be allocated". The candidate never reads carloan.mixed and prorates every original loan by carloan.financed, carloan.down and carloan.nonqualifying, so on a loan that financed only the vehicle it requires the amount financed, which the text does not need (all interest on such a loan is QPVLI). Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/carloan.deepseek.json): 102 of 141 comparisons agree; 32 candidate-unknown records are interview-produced loans with carloan.mixed false and no amount financed (stage12.car.basic, stage12.car.two_loans_cap); the value differences supply allocation amounts with carloan.mixed false (classm.f5695.6: $3,527.00 against $1,037.10) or column (ii) without a Schedule C (classm.carloan.4, as in the Claude log, where that difference alone is representation). The 4 project-unknown records withhold carloan.mixed, which the project asks before any allocation amount. Column (ii) handling is as ruled in the Claude log.

Ruling: representation; replacing only param sales.zero with its declared NonNegDollars value zero and ref carloan.col_ii_input with its printed input marker 22(ii) makes the canonical trees exactly equal. The raw input is the same published question; every eligibility, method, allocation, rounding and ScheduleC guard remains untouched. i1040gi (2025) p.110 line22 columns(ii)/(iii) subtracts the elsewhere-deducted amount. This ruling addresses identifiers/constant aliases, not a new tax interpretation.
